notes.title: New Demo - v0.4
notes.content:
Hello, snanchers!!

Thank you to all of you who played our demo so far!

Patch Notes Demo - v0.4
New
Decorations

Added a few of the decorations in the demo, so players can customize their ranch a bit more. More decorations will be available in the full version of the game.


Dragon can now cancel its current action. Right clicking on the same action it is currently doing will order the Dragon to cancel its action. This could help if the Dragon gets stuck with a task, or if simply a player wants to cancel a work without sending to a new task.


Fixes

A few bug fixes.


We hope everyone is enjoying this new version of the demo, with a bit more content! Developing of the rest of the game is moving smoothly!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/c3f3bee22c3de124fe4273ab591850b7f596a450.gif

As some may have noticed when starting a new game, the final version of Scaling Up will have different Dragon species to unlock! Here's a sneak peek of them!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/18155e0dee6fd310281bd9295912cbe50902dcc7.png

And if you have time, leave a review on the demo! It is really helpful to us! :)

notes.title: New Demo - v0.3
Slithering Digest #5 - New Demo Version NEXT WEEK!
notes.content:
Howdy, Rancherssssss!    

In this edition of Ssssssslithering Digessssssst we want to announce the next version of the demo and some features that will be included. I already mentioned some of them last edition, but let's recap it a bit.

Longer Demo duration
We are increasing the amount of in-game days available in the demo to 15 in-game Days. This will allow players to experience more of Scaling Up, the mechanics and available expeditions in the game.

Research System
As part of the next version of the demo, we are adding part of the Research System together with the Viper Lab. Using this building and with the assistance of the Researcher Vipers, players will be able to unlock more Snakes and Buildings in the game. As we are still working on the Research mechanics, only a portion of this feature will be available in the demo, since we still need to work on all the Research nodes and features for the full game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/c178d7493b5198e6cbf7bc12bb6cfd6201564053.gif
The Research System will be useful to upgrade the facilities, their capabilities and finding new Snake types in the game.

Ranch Expansion
Another feature recently developed that will be added in a new version of the demo is the Ranch Expansion! Players will be able to unlock the areas around the Ranch, getting more space to add more buildings. This will allow players to have more Snakes and buildings in their Ranch.

Temporary Save
We are working on a temporary Save File for the demo, so players can play the demo of Scaling Up to the final 15 in-game days in multiple play sessions, rather than a single play. Unfortunately the Save won't carry over to the final game as we are still working on content, adjusting how the save works and a lot of other systems in the game that will alter how saves work in the final version, so the Save File won't be the same.

Encyclopedia
The Encyclopedia is a feature in-game that will record Insects and Fishes collect during any playthrough. It is a system that is independent of the save, so it can record Insects and Fishes that are from different areas, saving them in the overall game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/0f594d214988827b8c314bdc515cd316bf33c007.gif
Players can collect insects that appear on the screen in various places, each with their own rarity.
As for the fishes, the Dragon and the Snakes will automatically collect and record them while fishing. Some fishing rods may even help with completing the encyclopedia!

This is all for the Sssssslithering Digesssst today! 

Until the next one!

notes.title: Slithering Digest #3 - Demo Rework
notes.content:
Howdy, Rancherssssss!    

Welcome back to the Ssssssslithering Digessssssst!   

Scaling Up is now the focus of our development! Now that we have completed and released the 1.0 of our other game Crafty Survivors on May 16th, we have been back focusing on the development of Scaling Up. 

To start, we are reworking the Demo based on some feedback from our community and other things we have planned, and we will be updating it in the future, with adjusted mechanics to improve the experience of the game.   

Let's talk a bit about some of the things in the next version of the demo: 

Gathering Spot Interaction
Something that was missing in the initial demo and we wanted to add when we could was the ability to assign workers directly to the Gathering Spots (Trees, Rocks, Grasses and Fishing Spots). As players may have noticed, the slots had a plus (+) sign on these spots, but their functionality was missing. This will be working in the new version of the demo as intended, which will allow players to have more options of assigning Snakes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/cafa91a5919360ff98e7323114735e481856c55a.gif"]
This is only available for Snakes, since the Dragon can be directly assigned by right clicking on a desired spot, which is a lot more straightforward.

Directly Select Snakes
Another feature coming in the demo is the ability to directly select a Worker Snake in the area instead of relying on the Building. This will open the same Menu as before, with the Snake already selected, making it easier to change equipments, reassign work and other important features for each Snake.

This feature will be available for worker snakes that leave their building to work, such as Gatherers and Fishers, among others. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/218a03e6af1a5a813714e7d35de66df883e56f86.gif"]

Caretaker Temple and Python Stations changes
We are changing the way these buildings work inside the game. Instead of directly telling the Snakes where to go, both buildings will have a pre-determined working area and Snakes residing on these facilities will automatically work on any buildings inside their area. Players won't have to manage Snakes separately anymore, but Snakes won't work on facilities far away from their own building.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/7960ff8075b2bad85ad7e253af84ce62229568c2.gif"]
The area of these buildings start small and through the Research system players will be able to increase the size of the working area.

Other News
In the future we are going to start a "Design Your Snake" contest for the community in different platforms, so players can have a chance to make some Snake designs of their own and maybe some can be added to the final game.
I will give more information about this contest later in another Slithering Digest. So for those interested in it, don't miss out.

This is all for the Sssssslithering Digesssst today! 

Until the next one!

notes.title: Become a Snake Rancher! Play the Demo!
notes.content:
Howdy, ranchers!

We have been working a lot lately on Scaling Up and today is an important date:

The Demo is OUT now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/28e0a2af7152d30fb0fd2f91f77fab5776456e96.gif

We are very excited to bring this demo to life and introduce the first experience of Scaling Up to everyone. This is our next game in the making!

We have been working on it a bit over 3 months so far and this is an exhilarating moment for us!! We can't wait for everyone to try it and share your thoughts about the game with us!

A little overview of what to expect with Scaling Up's Demo:

Players will have access to 7 in-game days with this demo;
8 different facilities to build;
11 species of Snakes for your Ranch, each with their own features;
5 Expeditions to gather materials;
Multiple equipments to Craft and improve your workers.


You can replay the 7 in-game days as many time as you wish to try different approaches to your Ranch and how you want it to work, just closing the game and opening it up again from the Settings Menu. This demo doesn't save progress yet, so quitting the game will reset the progress to zero and progress will not carry over to the full game.

We hope you enjoy this first look into Scaling Up and the Snakes in the game! We are happy to hear about your thoughts here or over at our Discord, if you decide to join us there. And share the layouts of your mini Ranch with us (just make sure to get your screenshot before 6:00 AM of DAY 8).

NOW GO!!! Play our Demo :) and create your Snake Ranch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/92fa22e9a659a86353b841b4faac699a4be9ac52.gif

notes.title: Slithering Digest #2 - The Year of the Snakes
notes.content:
Howdy, Rancherssssss!

Welcome back to the Ssssssslithering Digessssssst! 
It is the Year of the Snake! Quite fitting to feature these beauties on today's Digest, right?

So today let's start talking about the Snakes and their categories in Scaling Up.

Snake Categories
Snakes are divided into different categories, each fitting their own buildings and what they bring to the ranch. In their category, each Snake also provides a specific Scale related to their Species, which can be used to construct buildings, upgrade them or craft various equipments.

Serpentarium (or Barn) Snakes
These lovable Snakes require care and attention as much as possible and they will reward the players with their beautiful and more valuable scales. They need to be fed once a day to maintain their happiness so they can produce their daily scales.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/28e0a2af7152d30fb0fd2f91f77fab5776456e96.gif

There are different types of Serpentariums to build, that can house a variety of gentle snakes that will walk around their limited areas, from ground buildings to water ponds. Each scale provided by one of these Snakes will be used to build new facilities, upgrade existing ones or even make important equipments for other snakes in the settlement. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/9041fe8c546a1830afe694a9753c6b30599829e2.png

Gatherer Snakes
These diligent workers can assist with gathering resources in the ranch or during expeditions. They are capable of feeding themselves when hungry without supervision, producing their scales once a day if they ate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/92fa22e9a659a86353b841b4faac699a4be9ac52.gif

Gatherer Snakes live on the Gatherer's Den, a special building that can house a certain number of them. Some of these snakes have special capabilities which allow them to reach certain areas in expeditions and perform their tasks appropriately under certain special conditions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/13043d8495876c39c5d95187e36e017cd5b2846a.png

Fisher Snakes
Residents of the Fishing Cabin, these snakes are responsible for using the various fishing spots around the area to gather food for the settlement. They can feed themselves when necessary, producing their scales once a day if they ate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/da656c402e5dd379352d397cd454c206bd602006.gif

Different species of Fisher Snakes have different methods of fishing and can fish during different times of the day: some of them will only work during the day while others will only work during the night. A balance between species can guarantee more food resources.

Caretaker Snakes
These adorable snakes are adept in taking care of other species. Each Caretaker species has a different role in the ranch to assist the Dragon with their recurring tasks, such as feeding other species. They are capable of feeding themselves when hungry and will produce their scales once a day if they ate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/52f3b20db0a7f79c8eef01907c2a9b2d6396e532.gif

Transport Pythons
These Pythons are responsible for collecting the Scales of other snakes of the buildings they are assigned to. They will feed themselves and deposit their own scales through their day.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/89f410aa4163fb785df685869b44fd9e6a18c8a9.gif

Different species of Transport Pythons can work more efficiently depending on special weather!

Fighter Serpents
Serpents proficient in hunting and combat, these creatures can go on expeditions to gather food for the rest of the settlement. They can feed themselves when hungry without supervision, producing their scales once a day if they ate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/9a14776036adbfa3f64e14b0fc2357d1b86ea690.gif

Fighter Serpents live on the Serpentine Barracks, a special building that can house a certain number of them and has some limited spots for training. Some of these snakes have special capabilities which allow them to reach certain areas in expeditions and perform their tasks appropriately under certain special conditions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/41b3aad2f611dbb1b4375cc2deafc02a64c95b46.png

Smith Snakes
Workers of the Scale Forge, Smith Snakes have the toughest scales in existence and can use their own bodies to mold metal to their will, creating equipments and tools for other snakes to improve their performance in their tasks. Being so focused in their work, they need to be fed once a day to maintain their performance and to produce their daily scales.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/c3f3bee22c3de124fe4273ab591850b7f596a450.gif

Different species of Smith Snakes can forge different things, such as tools or armours, or even processing materials into more complex items.

Cook Cobras
These Cobras will create more complex meals to fulfill the necessity of certain species and their dietary needs, utilizing their proficiencies and certain resources gathered. Even though they work with food, they are too focused on their jobs to be able to feed themselves alone, so they require certain caretaking to keep their performance up and produce their daily scales.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/e0a9c0fd70d054456e818f32289c101cfd4a61bc.gif

Different species of Cobras can cook different types of meals, so a variety of them is necessary to fulfill all the needs in the settlement.

Scientist Vipers
The smartest of these creatures, Scientist Vipers are focused on the development of the settlement and the discovery of new things. They are a vital part of the ranch as they can research new species of Snakes, new buildings and upgrades that are necessary to scale up the operations. 

Different species of these Vipers will work differently depending on weather conditions.


We are working now on a Demo for Steam Next Fest this Month of February!! So keep an eye on it to get a first feel of Scaling Up soon! 

This is all for the Sssssslithering Digesssst today! 

Until the next one!

notes.title: Slithering Digest #1 - Dive deep into Scaling Up
notes.content:
Howdy, Rancherssssss!

Welcome to the Ssssssslithering Digessssssst! A sort of "newssssssletter" or something similar, to get more into the world of Scaling Up and what it is all about! 
For those who came here from our other game, Crafty Survivors, think about this as the Daily Newton that sometimes pops up in the Community Hub (you can see the similarities in the artwork as well), with a  bit more of information about the game's features before the release. We want to bring more about the game to you all, so you can have a better idea of what to expect with Scaling Up.

So today let's start talking about some of the features of Scaling Up.

Building Facilities
With the Side menu, players will be able to choose the facilities they want or need to build on their ranch to start their operations, as long as they have the appropriate resources to build one. There is a variety of facilities to choose, each housing different types of snakes that either need to be cared for or can help in the ranch's activities. 
Upon choosing the desired building, players can position it anywhere they want, as long as the space allows for it and right click to command the Dragon to start construction. The Dragon is the only entity in-game that can build facilities.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/6dfd33707f64c02849b8887d4f527a2ec6fc96d5.gif
Don't worry about the placement though, as all buildings can be moved around as long as there's a space open for it.

Upgrade Facilities
Most buildings have a few Tiers of upgrade that will unlock more space to house more snakes. These upgrades require some materials and the Dragon must be sent to start construction after the upgrade is started. The Dragon is the only entity in-game that can upgrade facilities.

Gathering Resources
There are several resources to be gathered in Scaling Up. Some of the base initial resources can be found around the Ranch, as players will need to clean up the area to open up space to build more facilities, gaining some materials in the process. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/4c7afd77bd85057ba569b2b8a006629ac6d4e19c.gif
Certain buildings and researches will require other materials that can't be found in the ranch, so players will be able to do Expeditions on different areas to acquire those resources. We will talk more about Expeditions in another Digest.

Snake Store
Each building in the game (aside from the Dragon's Nest) can house a certain category of Snake and a different number of Snakes from said category. After constructing a new facility, players will have access to their Snake Store and they will be able to add a new Snake to the building using the in-game resources. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/7d0a1a543da682099c6f118777daf28ba044a746.gif
There is a big variety of Snakes, each with their own Scales to collect and use as building/research materials, and specific attributes that might allow them to perform tasks at unique places or under certain conditions. We will dive more into the different categories and some of the unique Snakes in another Digest.

Assign Snakes to Automate Tasks
With more tasks to be done and just the Dragon to do them, worker Snakes will be an asset to assist with many of the various jobs around the ranch, aside from building and upgrading facilities. From gathering resources to forging equipments, Snakes are there to help with a lot of tasks and gift the player with their beautiful scales as long as they are properly fed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/77138ce5322ea16d5749ef2229930948b403aa70.gif

Speed Up and Pause
At the bottom right of the screen, players will have access to some control options that allow them to speed up the game when desired, if they want things to go a bit faster. There will be multiple options of speed to fit different needs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/0e957fe57137c432b96cb7242a9d9e4314683b26.gif
Players can also pause the time in order to plan next steps or any other reasons they have. 

Zoom In and Zoom Out
Need to zoom out to take a better look and plan further the position of facilities? Or zoom in on a specific part to watch the work done by the Dragon or the Snakes? Next to the speed controls, 2 buttons will allow players to change the distance of the camera to a few fixed sizes (they need to be fixed in order to keep the graphics of the game from breaking).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325324/ca17e5cb409d269ad0340dad36f2f20da96fe6c3.gif

This is all for the Sssssslithering Digesssst today! 

Until the next one!
